stem.archstudio.design_invalid: Enter whole numbers within the displayed limits.
stem.archstudio.design_bounds: This design extends outside X/Z -64 to 64 or Y 0 to 31. Adjust its origin or dimensions.
stem.archstudio.design_capacity: This operation exceeds the 4,096-block limit. Reduce the size or selection.
stem.archstudio.design_region_invalid: Enter valid coordinates for both corners of the region.
stem.archstudio.design_empty: No blocks are inside this region. Select a floor or change the corners.
stem.archstudio.design_collision: {count} occupied cells conflict with this operation. Change the position or offset.
stem.archstudio.design_unchanged: This operation would make no change.
stem.archstudio.design_replay: Exit construction replay before editing the live build.
stem.archstudio.design_built: Added {count} blocks. Undo restores the previous build.
stem.archstudio.design_moved: Moved {count} blocks. The region follows the selection.
stem.archstudio.design_duplicated: Copied {count} blocks. The new copy is selected.
stem.archstudio.design_painted: Updated the material and color of {count} blocks.
stem.archstudio.design_deleted: Removed {count} blocks. Use Undo to restore them.
stem.archstudio.design_plan_label: Proposed design, top view. Crosses mark occupied cells.
stem.archstudio.design_plan_caption: Top view • entrance on the minimum-Z wall
stem.archstudio.design_top_view: Top view • X across, Z down
stem.archstudio.design_origin: Origin • lower corner, in grid units
stem.archstudio.design_scale_note: Dimensions use grid units. Rooms include a solid base; wall height starts above it. Costs are studio credits.
stem.archstudio.design_region_help: Select every block between two corners, including hidden layers and filtered materials.
stem.archstudio.design_selection_hint: The cyan outline marks your region in 3D; selected floor-grid cells have cyan borders.
stem.archstudio.design_rotation_note: Turns around Y and swaps width/depth, anchored at the selection’s minimum X/Z corner.
stem.archstudio.design_delete_note: Removes the selected blocks from every included layer. This is one undo step.
stem.archstudio.design_already_added: Design added. Change the origin to add another, or use Region edits to transform it.
